item.content:encoded:
I think he would perceive them as slightly different. He has some awareness of the text in a book-he can tell if there are typos, and particularly hard-to-parse books are difficult for him-but he also experiences the events of a book. I think he'd recognize they're basically the same story, but he'd come across with a different "feel" from each of them, depending on how different they were from each other.

He probably wouldn't notice a mistranslation unless he either had experienced the original (or other translations) or if was egregious enough not to make sense (like using a completely unsuitable word). He would experience it as written in the translation.
